slot.brief: Sentence using simple past with 'since/for' time expressions; choose the option that corrects it to present perfect/present perfect continuous.

stem: Choose the best improvement for the underlined part: <u>She worked at the research centre since 2021</u>, contributing to several important studies.
options: She has worked at the research centre since 2021
She had worked at the research centre since 2021
She is working at the research centre since 2021
She works at the research centre since 2021

verdicts.working: “Since 2021” for work continuing to the present calls for the present perfect: “has worked.”

working:
“Since 2021” marks a period continuing to the present, so use the present perfect: “has worked.” The past perfect, present continuous and simple present do not fit this time expression here.

Independent check: “Since 2021” for work continuing to the present calls for the present perfect: “has worked.”
solution: “Since 2021” indicates an action continuing to the present, so the present perfect is used: “She has worked at the research centre since 2021.”
